source.runtime: packaged-app on server computer with physical SPOT device

limitations: The monitoring loop completed, but its first final JSON serialization failed because Windows PowerShell 5.1 could not convert a Generic.List object through array subexpression syntax.
The exact validation window was recovered from the in-memory observability queue before it was cleared or the application was stopped.
Continuous health sample arrays and counter deltas were not preserved; the approval scope is the SPOT image timeout regression, its observability errors, and the final driver/poll state.
